items.title: Gagliano selected as a Manning Star of the Week
items.summary: NEW ORLEANS (November 9, 2026) – Middle Tennessee's Roman Gagliano was selected as one of eight quarterbacks for the Manning Award Stars of the Week as announced by the Allstate Sugar Bowl on Monday.

items.title: Butler named CUSA Freshman of the Week
items.summary: DALLAS – Wide receiver Ziyon Butler was named the Conference USA Freshman of the Week following his career day in the win over WKU Saturday, as announced by the league office on Monday.

items.title: Late heroics lead the way as Blue Raiders down WKU on Homecoming
items.summary: MURFREESBORO, Tenn.- With 31 seconds left in the fourth quarter in a 42-42 game, Middle Tennessee (5-4, 3-2 CUSA) was scratching and clawing for its first win over rival Western Kentucky (3-6, 2-3 CUSA) in seven years. 31 seconds later, Middle Tennessee claimed a 51-42 win over that team in red, in possibly the most chaotic sequence of the college football season.

items.title: Blue Raiders face WKU for Homecoming Saturday
Countdown to Kickoff Luncheon set for Friday ahead of Homecoming
items.summary: MURFREESBORO, Tenn. — Middle Tennessee football fans will have an opportunity to get an inside look at Saturday's conference matchup with WKU when the Blue Raiders host the Countdown to Kickoff Luncheon Friday, Nov. 6, at 11:45 a.m. in the SRM Concrete Club at Floyd Stadium.

items.title: Blue Raiders drop weeknight finale to Kennesaw
items.summary: MURFREESBORO, Tenn.- On its final weeknight game of the season Middle Tennessee (4-4, 2-2 CUSA) lost momentum in the second half, falling to Kennesaw State (2-6, 1-3 CUSA) 44-28.

items.title: Blue Raiders face defending CUSA Champs at Floyd tonight
Bourgeois named a Lou Groza "Star of the Week"
items.summary: Senior place-kicker Dominic Bourgeois was selected as a Lou Groza Award "Star of the Week" for his performance in the win over FIU last week. Bourgeois was also tabbed earlier this week as the CUSA Special Teams Player of the Week.

items.title: Countdown to Kickoff Luncheon set for Tuesday
items.summary: MURFREESBORO, Tenn. — Middle Tennessee football fans will have an opportunity to get an inside look at Wednesday's conference matchup with Kennesaw State when the Blue Raiders host the Countdown to Kickoff Luncheon Tuesday, Oct. 27, at 11:45 a.m. in the SRM Concrete Club at Floyd Stadium.

items.title: Bourgeois earns second CUSA Special Teams Player of the Week honor
items.summary: MURFREESBORO – Senior place-kicker Dominic Bourgeois was voted the CUSA Special Teams Player of the Week as announced by the league office on Monday. This marks the second honor for Bourgeois this season.
